Commentary.Commentary: The Bangladesh players are now posing with the trophy. They are a happy bunch and want to savor this moment of accomplishment. It's also time for us to sign off. We look forward to your company for the first ODI on 9th December at 1400 local (0800 GMT). Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Bangladesh's skipper, Shakib Al Hasan is chosen for the Player of the Series award. Says that this is something he and the coaching staff want from the team. He is thrilled with the overall team effort. Points that every time the batsmen who got in tried to make it count. Praises all the spinners for the way they bowled in this Test match and gives a special mention to Mehidy Hasan. Lauds Naeem Hasan and Shadman Islam as well for showing good composure and he feels that they can do well in the international arena. Mentions that he cannot ask more than this from his team but quickly says that there is always room for improvement. On his own performance, Shakib admits that he was a bit rusty in the first Test as he trained for only 2-3 sessions and this match was much more comfortable. Reckons he will be at his best in the ODI series.

Player of the Match, Mehidy Hasan is smiling and says that he is delighted to get this award after a long time. States that he received good support from the other end from Shakib and Taijul. He is really happy with the win. Adds that he likes batting and goes on to say that their batsmen set the tone by posting 500-plus on the board which made the job easier for the bowlers.

Windies' skipper Kraigg Brathwaite says that his bowlers bowled well in this series and that's one of the few positives for them. Praises the batting of Hetmyer and Dowrich (first innings) as well but admits that other batsmen need to show more application. Feels that they didn't get enough partnerships going. States that Test cricket is mentally tough and they have a few FC matches to go before facing England. Mentions that to stay positive is the key and hopes to get better in the ODIs.

Everything went according to the plan for Bangladesh. They won an important toss and aimed to bat once by posting a big total. Debutant Shadman Islam, Mahmudullah and Shakib Al Hasan played important roles in taking them to a total over 500. The Windies bowlers, especially the spinners, failed to deliver on a helpful surface and this was also one of the prime reasons for this embarrassing loss for the tourists. Just for the record, this is Bangladesh's first ever Test series win over Windies at home and it truly is a historic one.

It was a pretty dismal show by Windies. They didn't benefit much from the Test series in India. Their batsmen lacked the required skill and technique to play spinners and were exposed. Application and temperament, two key characteristics to succeed in Test cricket were also missing. Shimron Hetmyer did show his ability with the bat as he made an attacking 93 while the last pair also sent a message to the top order on how to apply in tough conditions.

All over in the blink of an eye! Bangladesh have beaten Windies comprehensively to take the Test series 2-0! Dominance, that's the word to describe their performance. Their spinners were relentless and Mehidy Hasan was ruthless. He bagged a 12-wicket haul, his personal best in Tests and starred the day where 15 wickets fell.

OUT! BANGLADESH WIN BY AN INNINGS AND 184 RUNS! A nicely tossed up delivery, landing around leg and straightening from there. Lewis tries to flick but misses and is rapped on the pads. They appeal and the umpire nods before raising his finger. The number 11 reviews it but the Ball Tracker shows three reds. Impact in line and it's hitting middle and leg. Bangladesh can continue with their celebration. Their first ever win by an innings! Historic day.
Sherman Lewis is given out lbw. Looks gone. But he is reviewing it. The Bangladesh players are seen already congratulating each other. Let's see...
Full and on off, defended off the front foot.
Straighter delivery, turned in front of square leg for a run. This pair has now frustrated Bangladesh for 69 balls. The partnership is worth 42. Last over before Tea coming up now...
Arm ball outside off, nicely read by Sherman who allows it through to the keeper.
Fuller and outside off, driven down through extra cover for a run.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Quicker one, darted on middle, defended off the back foot.
Floated one, full and on off, Sherman defends it watchfully. The number 11 is showing a better technique than the top order. He is applying himself. Putting a price on his wicket. Good to see.
Drags his length short and lands it outside off, Lewis goes back and pulls it against the spin to wide mid on.
Shortish on off, punched to the off side.
Loopy and full on off, Sherman pushes it out off his front foot to point.
Flatter on off, Lewis blocks it back rather easily.
Slower this time, full and around off, Lewis defends it by going inside the crease at the last moment.
Quicker and on off, defended off the back foot.
Off spinner outside off, Roach fails to make contact.
Brings out the broom now. Sweeps this behind square for a couple of runs. This stand is starting to get frustrating now.
FOUR! That's a proper cricket shot! Sees the ball given air on off, Roach drives it through covers for a beautiful boundary.
Around off, Lewis lofts this towards mid off. They cross.
On off, punched off the back foot by Lewis.
Down the leg side, Lewis looks to turn it away but cannot get bat to ball.
Jaffa! Quicker ball on middle, it spins sharply and almost kisses the outside edge. Beauty!
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Outside off, guided to the slip cordon.
FOUR! Lewis and Roach continue to make merry. Lewis this time gets low and slogs this over mid-wicket, through the gap, for a boundary.
Outside off, Lewis shoulders his arms to it.
Around off, kept out ahead of the silly point fielder.
On middle, blocked by Roach.

FOUR! Lovely batting! Swipes this through square leg to get back-to-back boundaries. Playing a nice little knock. And these shots are showing that there is certainly no demon in this pitch. Windies have only themselves to blame for this sorry performance.
FOUR! Full and on middle and leg, Roach gets under it and lofts it over mid on for a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Nice delivery holds its line. Around off, Roach tries to poke at it but cannot get bat to ball.
Tossed up ball on off, driven to the cover region.
Maiden over. Full and on off, dug out well by Lewis.
Played to mid-wicket region by Sherman.
Gets behind this ball and dead-bats it.
Loopy ball around off, played to the point region.
On middle and off this time, Lewis stonewalls it.
On middle and leg, turned away to the on side.
Solid. Roach has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Angling in around off, Roach tries to defend by getting forward but it spins away to beat the outside edge.
Swing and a miss! Spinning away from the batsman, Roach throws his bat at it but misses.
Full and around off, Roach is forward and defends it off the outer half to silly point.
Presses forward to a full ball again and defends it watchfully.
Flatter and full on off, an arm ball, Roach is forward as he blocks.
Driven through the covers by Roach. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Flighted ball in line of the stumps, Roach lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Tossed up ball on middle and off, bunted down by Roach.
On off, punched to mid off by Kemar.
The batsman has driven it through mid on.
Outside off, Roach looks to block it but cannot get bat to ball.
Down leg yet again, flicked away with a wristy shot to short mid-wicket.
Gives this air on middle and leg, Lewis misses his shot and gets hit on his leg.
On middle and leg, once again pushed to that man near mid on.
Darts this on the toes of Lewis who turns it to mid-wicket.
Flighted ball on off, Lewis plays it into the ground.
On the legs of Lewis who flicks it through square leg for a couple of runs.
On off, kept out.
On off, Lewis hits it through mid on for a single.
PEACH! Looped up on middle, it spins away from Lewis who is forward to block. Misses it completely but keeps his back leg inside the crease.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Covers his stumps and blocks this out solidly.
Down leg, Roach fails to make contact and was hit low on the pads down the leg side.
Taijul Islam in for another spell.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On the pads, worked away through square leg for another run.
Milks this through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Tossed up ball in line of the stumps, Lewis deliberately lofts it over the bowler's head. Mid on and mid off chase it but neither can cut it off. Boundary.
Played to the mid-wicket region by Lewis.
Darts this down leg, Lewis looks to sweep but fails.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.
A tad short outside off, cut past backward point for a brace.
Outside off, Lewis looks to drive it but cannot get bat to ball.

OUT! You cannot keep Mehidy Hasan out of action in this Test match! Another 5-wicket haul in this match. Loopy ball in line of the stumps, Jomel just chips it back to Hasan who takes the simplest of catches. Catching practice, literally. Nine down now and Sherman Lewis is the last man in.
Full on off, Jomel reaches for it and helps it towards mid-wicket.
Flighted ball in line of the stumps, Warrican taps it in front of himself.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Uppish but safe. Driven to covers once again.
FOUR! Lovely! Full and on off, Roach creams it through covers. No protection there and the ball races away. He gets his third boundary through that region.
On off, punched to the off side.
Down the leg side, turned away around the corner.
Full and on off, driven away from the cover fielder but no run taken.
Full around off, driven back to the bowler.
Plays this one with the spin but straight to short leg.
Turning down the leg side, the batsman fails to flick and Rahim also fails to collect. They cross for a bye.
Roach has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Jomel Warrican walks in.

OUT! Hetmyer holes out! Once again tries to go downtown and clear the fence but this time he mistimes his shot in the air. Fails to get underneath the ball and it skies up in the air at long off. Mithun makes no mistake in the deep and Mehidy is ecstatic. Points at his skipper, maybe telling him that's why he wanted a fielder there in the deep. Hetmyer departs, 7 runs short of his maiden Test hundred. He should be disappointed but it was an entertaining knock to say the least.
SIX! Biggie number 9 for Shimron Hetmyer! A flighted full ball around off, Hetmyer makes room, uses his feet and dispatches it over the bowler's head.
Tossed up ball on off, Roach defends it solidly off the front foot.
Works it with the spin to the on side, not in the gap.
Loopy delivery landing outside off and turning back in, Roach tries to drive but it spins in and takes the inside half of the bat. Rolls back to the bowler.
Fetches a full ball from outside off and sweeps it firmly to deep mid-wicket for a run. This is now his highest Test score.
Shortish and on middle, Hetmyer defends it off his back foot.
Lunges to a full ball and defends it back.
FOUR! Another delightful drive from Roach's bat. The length is very full outside off and he crunches his drive through extra cover for a boundary.
Muted appeal for bat-pad! Spin and bounce from around middle, Roach fails to put bat on ball and it lops off his pads to short leg.
Roach has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Quality shot from a number 9 batsman. Full and flighted delivery outside off, Kemar reaches out for it and drills his drive through covers.
Action replay of the previous delivery. This time Rahim puts in an appeal after collecting the ball but nothing from the umpire.
Beaten! Off spinner landing outside off. Roach draws forward to defend but it doesn't turn in as much and beats the outside edge.
Tossed up ball outside off, driven to the left of mid off fielder for a run.

Missing leg, it is. A big off spinner. Landing outside off and curling back in, Roach decides to play it from the back foot but misses. He is rapped on the pads and they put in an unsuccessful appeal. Shakib goes for the DRS after consulting his players. The replays roll in and they show it to be easily going down. The hosts have no reviews left now.
Shout for an lbw! Not given. Bangladesh take the DRS. Looks like missing leg. Let's see...
Shifts on his back foot and punches it wide of mid off for a run.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! First from Shimron's bat to go with 8 sixes. Loopy and around leg, Hetmyer sits down on one knee and smokes it over backward square leg. It drops safely in the deep and then crosses the rope.
Very full and around leg, Hetmyer defends it back to the bowler.
Tossed up ball on off, defended off the front foot to the leg side.
Presses forward and plays it behind point for a couple.
Kemar Roach arrives.

OUT! Great reflex catch at first slip and Mehidy gets his 10-wicket haul in the match. This is the second time he has achieved this feat in Tests. Wow. Hasan dishes out a short delivery outside off and seeing that Bishoo goes on the back foot to play the square cut. But it takes the outside edge of his bat and Sarkar hangs on to a sharp catch over his head. In the first innings also, Bishoo tried to cut and was caught brilliantly at silly point. So two great catches to dismiss Bishoo twice in a day.
Drops it full on off and Bishoo is forward in defense.
Again it's flat, around off, Bishoo blocks it from the crease.
Flatter and on off, fired in, Bishoo gets forward and defends.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Lunges to defend but gets an outside edge wide of first slip. A single taken.

Appeal for an lbw! Not entertained by the umpire. Tossed up ball landing outside off, Bishoo fails to sweep and gets hit on the pads. It deflects down to fine leg and they cross for a couple of leg byes. Not much thought given to use the DRS. Rightly so.
Slower through the air, it's full and around off, Bishoo pushes it off his front foot to covers.
Jumps out of the crease and nearly yorks himself. Still does well to force it down towards long on for a run.
Fullish and on off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
Full and flighted on middle, driven off the front foot to extra cover.
Flat and short on middle, blocked from the back foot.
Leans forward to a full ball and blocks it back to the bowler.
Defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Tossed up ball on middle and leg, Bishoo gets forward and defends it to mid-wicket.
Flatter and shorter on off, Hetmyer gets deep inside the crease and cuts it straight to point.
Another delivery straight enough to be worked on the leg side for a run.
Too straight in line, Bishoo helps it away through mid-wicket for two.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They take a run.
Stays back footed and this time mistimes his punch to covers.
Goes back and punches it to the bowler.
A slider on middle, Bishoo tries to defend again but it takes the inside edge and goes to fine leg. They take a couple of runs.
On middle, Bishoo prods forward and defends it.
Loopy ball on leg, turned towards mid-wicket.
Darts this full on the pads, Bishoo looks to flick it but gets hit on his boots down the leg side.
Another couple. Down the leg side, helped on its way towards fine leg for a brace.
Low full toss on the legs, flicked away through square leg for a brace.
Mehidy Hasan is back into the attack.
Looks to take the run but cannot. Taps this with soft hands towards point and then refuses the single. He will want to get to his maiden Test ton.
Spins away from him, he cuts it towards the point region.
Goes back and keeps this one out off his back foot.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads.
Covers his stumps and blocks this one out.
Hetmyer defends it from within the crease.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Yes he takes runs too. Cuts this past point for a single.
SIX! 8! This one straight! Floated ball in line of the stumps, Hetmyer lofts this straight back over the bowler for the third six of the over. This is carnage from Shimron.

SIX! Make that seven! Another slog. Tossed up ball on middle and leg, he slogs it over mid-wicket. This time he doesn't get it well enough but such is the power on those shoulders that it goes well over the ropes.
On the pads, turned away to the on side.
SIX! He is only dealing in sixes! His 6th so far, without any fours. Tossed up ball on middle, Hetmyer slogs this over square leg for a biggie.
Gets forward and drives it towards extra cover.
Strides forward to defend but it spins away to beat his bat.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flighted and on middle, defended off the front foot.
Streaky! Loopy and spinning away from the southpaw, Hetmyer tries to play the cover drive but it takes the outside half of his bat and runs wide of backward point. They take three runs.
Lunges to a full ball and offers a straight bat in defense.

Did that carry? Flatter full around off, Bishoo pushes firmly inside the line and gets an outside edge. The first slip fielder dives across to his left but it gets deflected off his hands to deep point. A couple taken.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Gets forward to a full ball and blocks it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Going down the leg side, Hetmyer fails to flick and Rahim also fails to collect. A couple of byes taken.

SIX! Hetmyer will keep playing his natural game. Floated full ball around middle and off, Shimron jumps out of the crease and hoists it over long on for a maximum. He has a smile on his face. A mighty blow from his bat. Fifth six for him, hasn't hit a single four in this innings so far.
Bowls a full ball in the line outside off, Bishoo drives without any fear but it has gone straight to the cover fielder.
Once again the length is very full and Bishoo keeps it out safely.
Fires in a yorker around middle and leg, Bishoo digs it out at the last moment.
Full and around off, defended back off the front foot.

Drinks break. Windies have offered a fight but are still losing wickets at regular intervals. Bangladesh are now just four wickets away from registering a massive innings victory. Devendra Bishoo is the new batsman.

OUT! Big blow to Windies. Dowrich is caught at first slip. Naeem serves a flighted delivery around off from 'round the wicket, Shane tries to flick it across the line with the spin but it doesn't spin back in much and takes the outside edge on its way to Soumya Sarkar. A good low catch by him. Into the tail now, Bangladesh.

This one is a little short around off, Hetmyer rocks back and punches it to sweeper cover for a run. Brings up his 4th Test fifty. He has at least offered a fight here. Shimron has got the skills, just need better application. We saw that in India as well. Needs to continue though...
Short around off, punched from the back foot but straight to the cover fielder.
Loopy one on off, Dowrich strides forward and works it across the line towards square leg.
This one is quite wide outside off, Shane has nothing to do with it.
Full and outside off, driven straight to the cover fielder.

Goes aerially but it's safe. Loopy and around off, Hetmyer chips it over mid off for a run. His intention was to go inside-out over covers and miscues his shot. Lucky that it goes on one bounce to the fielder in the deep.
Fullish and on middle, Shimron defends it back off his front foot.
Shakib is back on.
Naeem bowls short around off, Dowrich cuts from the back foot but doesn't time it well.
Another delivery spinning down the leg side has been left alone by Shane. He is reading Naeem well here.
Lets the ball spin down the leg side, no need to play at those.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a run.
Hetmyer has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Edged but safe! Hasan tosses it up in the air, slower one and lands it full outside off. It breaks away after landing and Hetmyer draws forward to play at it with soft hands.  But the ball takes the outside edge and dies in front of Sarkar at first slip.
A touch short and on off, Dowrich nicely gets behind the line and blocks it safely.
Strides forward to a full ball and pushes it with the spin to silly mid on.
Allows the ball to spin back in and helps it around the corner.
Loopy and on off, fuller in length, it's defended off the front foot.
Again a shortish delivery, outside off, Shimron cuts it off his back foot through cover-point for one.
Spinning back into the batsman from a shorter length around off, Dowrich moves back and works it through square leg for a run.
The batsman works it down the leg side towards square leg. They pick up a single. 6 from the over, Naeem hasn't found his rhythm yet.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it to mid on.
Tossed up ball on middle, Shimron eases it down through mid off for another run.
Full and spinning away, Hetmyer drives it through covers for a couple of runs.
Flighted delivery on off, driven down to long on again for one.
Goes on the back foot and punches it down to long on for a run.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Turning down the leg side, Dowrich tries to flick but misses.

Shane Dowrich walks in next. He looked the most assured batsman for Windies in the first innings. A bit strange that he didn't get the promotion in the batting order. Anyway, now it's up to him and Hetmyer yet again. The same pair that started the day's play.

OUT! Goodness gracious me. Shai Hope did all the hard work and has now thrown his wicket away. Mehidy drops it short around off, Hope gets back inside the crease with the pull shot and doesn't bother to keep it down. Maybe, he just wanted to play it wide of the short mid-wicket fielder. He did that successfully but there is a mid-wicket fielder present too. Shakib moves across to his left and grabs the catch with ease. The partnership which was blossoming is nipped in the bud. Mehidy is up and running in celebration. His 9th wicket in the match now.
Helps it with the spin to the leg side but finds the square leg fielder.
Flatter on middle, defended off the back foot to the leg side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Not afraid to take on the bowlers, is he? Tries lofting on but does not get the desired result. It goes towards long on and they take two.

DROPPED! Closer to the off pole. Too close to cut too. Hetmyer still goes for it. Gets an outside edge towards Rahim. It touches his glove as lobs to Sarkar at first slip who dives forward but couldn't get to it.
A bit on the shorter side again. Hetmyer punches it through covers. The fielder there gets a hand to it and stops it. They take two. Hetmyer still has no boundary to his name but 4 sixes.
Short and outside off, Shimron reaches for it and cannot get it past point. A rare miss from him.
Floated ball on off, tapped to the off side.
Around off, guided towards cover-point.
Outside off, stroked off the back foot towards point.
Crowd catch. Full and on middle, Hope punches it back to the bowler.
Short and outside off, Hetmyer cuts it past point for another single. The rotation of strike has been good so far.
Gives this air on middle, Shimron bunts it down.
Stays inside and keeps this one out to the off side.
Tossed up on off, Hetmyer plays it to the off side.
Shai gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
2 in 2. Looped up ball outside off, Hetmyer goes for the booming drive but fails to put bat on ball.
Flighted ball, turned to mid-wicket.
Flatter ball on off, Hetmyer is on his back foot as he looks to cut it but misses.
Flighted ball on off, Hetmyer showing his good defensive skills.
Down leg, Hope has flicked the ball off his pads.
Played with soft hands in front of square leg for one. The 50-run stand is up. Finally some fight from the visitors.
Full and on off, driven to covers.
Tucked around the corner for one.
Hope works it down the leg side.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Gets into position early and reverse sweeps it towards backward point for one.

Loopy ball outside off, Hope charges down to block it but his one hand comes off. It lobs towards short leg again where Shadman takes the catch. The players appeal but nothing from the umpire. No inside edge as replays suggests.

OUCH! That must have hurt. Outside off, Hope sweeps it hard. Shadman at short leg jumps but the ball hits the back of his ankle. It rebounds there, Rahim behind the stumps is alert and dives to take it but cannot get there in time. Meanwhile, Islam is receiving some treatment here.
Down leg, flicked away with a wristy shot to square leg.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

NOT OUT! Off spinner outside off, comes back in. Hope shuffles across and looks to work it but gets hit on his pads. The umpire stays put after the players appeal. Shakib decides to take it up after a while. Replays show us that the impact is way outside off. Bangladesh lose a review. Not the best use of the technology.
LBW review! After a long chat Shakib decides to review it. What do we have here?
Outside off, kept out. Hetmyer looks to be confident.
Floated ball outside off, pushed to the cover region. Turning out to be a good period of play for the visitors.
Well bowled. On leg, Shimron gets it off the inner half towards deep square leg for another couple.
No leg slip. On middle and leg, tucked away towards short fine leg for a run.
Full on off, driven back to the bowler.
Off spinner down the leg side. Hope tries to put bat to ball but fails.
On off, well blocked by Hetmyer.
Flighted ball outside off, Hetmyer blocks it.
Covers his stumps and keeps this one out.
Full and on off, Hetmyer gets a soft leading edge towards point.
Around off, played into the ground to the off side.
Asks questions straightaway. Lovely loop outside off, Hope looks to block it but misses. Goes past the keeper too towards third man for three byes.
Naeem Hasan to bowl for the first time today.
Dishes this on the leg side, Hetmyer rocks back and punches it near to the bowler.
Outside off, cut to point.
Full and on middle, milked away through mid-wicket for a single.
Floated ball on middle, Hope is solid in his defense.
Gets under this one and blocks it out.
Hope uses his feet and flicks it away through square leg for nothing.

SIX! Another biggie! Question is how long can he go like this. Another loopy ball on middle and leg, Hetmyer lofts it over cow corner for half a dozen. 14 from the over, this surely has come out of nowhere.

SIX! Hetmyer is not going to sit quietly. Playing his natural game. Pitched up ball on middle and leg, Hetmyer gets under it and lofts it over mid-wicket for a huge hit. There was a man back there but he could only watch it sail over.
Gives this air on middle and leg, clipped away towards square leg to change ends.
Flighted ball on off, played once again to the point region.
Around off, guided towards point.
Down leg, worked away around the corner for a single.
Pushed to the cover region by SH. They pick up a single.
Loopy ball on off, played to the off side.
Gets behind this ball and blocks it out.
Hetmyer has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
SIX! His second one! It was there to be hit. Short and outside off, Hetmyer rocks back and pulls it massively over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Tossed up ball on off, played with a straight bat.
Mehidy Hasan to bowl from the other end.
Short and outside off, nicely cut away to deep backward point for a couple of runs.
Full this time on off, driven to covers.
Another one given air on off, played to the off side.
Loopy ball on off, tapped in front of silly point.
Similar line and length, this time pushed to mid off.
Loopy ball on middle, punched back to Taijul.

Will this be the last session of the match? I won't be surprised. Heads I win, tails you lose. The players walk out to the middle. Shai Hope and Shimron Hetmyer have work to do. Bangladesh will continue their spin therapy with Taijul Islam.
... Day 3, Session 2 ...

Action-packed morning session! It's Bangladesh, Bangladesh and only Bangladesh. 9 wickets in total fell. Mehidy Hasan was the star and the other spinners also played good supporting roles. Windies didn't put up much fight in the first innings and lost their remaining five wickets in a jiffy. After that, following-on, the script didn't change much. The only thing consistent with Windies at the moment is being consistently poor with the bat. Playing across the line, premeditating a shot, getting caught inside the crease and loosely driving away from the body - this is what happened in the second essay of their batting. Already four down and let's see whether they can survive the next session or not. Do join us in a short while.
A long hop outside off, Hetmyer goes chasing after it and cuts it through point for a couple of runs. That will be Lunch on Day 3 and Mehidy Hasan is leading his team off the park.
Flatter one on middle, defended back from the crease.
Extra air this time. Loopy and landing full outside off, Hetmyer stretches forward to cover the line and then lets it through.
Around leg, Hope moves back and tucks it towards the square leg umpire. One more run added to the tally.
Gets this one to skid back in from around off. Hetmyer rocks back and punches it down to long on for one.
Starts with a short delivery outside off, Hetmyer gets back and cuts it through point for a couple of runs.
Mahmudullah to bowl the last over before Lunch.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Drops this one on leg and it turns down. Hetmyer tries flicking but misses. They appeal but it's missing leg.
SIX! He hit a maximum early in the morning also! Nice use of the feet by him. Rushes down the track to a full ball and launches it with the spin over long on. Positive intent is good to see.
Tossed up ball around off, Hope goes back to punch and it goes off the outer half of the blade through covers. One run added to the total.
Loopy full ball on middle, Hope lunges and blocks it solidly.
Hetmyer looks to block this but gets it off the inside half towards the short leg fielder.
Works this around the corner to get off strike.
Brave! Uses his feet and plays this with a straight bat towards mid on.
Full and on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Long appeal! But nothing from the umpire. Loopy ball on off, good revs on it. Turns too much perhaps. Going down leg as Hope gets hit on the pads.

Appeal for a catch, nothing from the umpire. Spinning down, Hetmyer tries flicking but misses. It goes off his pads to leg slip and they appeal. No wood involved. Shakib was advised not to take the referral.
Turning down the leg side, Shimron fails to flick and is hit on the pads. A stifled appeal dies down quickly.
Shimron Hetmyer is the new batsman.

OUT! Chase doesn't want to fight either. He's considered to be the best batsman against spinners in this Windies line-up. Disappointing. A tossed up delivery outside off, full in length and turning away. Chase with a sorry footwork goes for a drive and hits it aerially to covers. Mominul takes a good low catch. His front foot never came forward to the pitch of the delivery. Four down already, this is the repeat telecast of last evening.
Floated and outside off, defended by Chase off the front foot.
Follows it up with a delivery in the line of the stumps. Shai gets back and helps it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Slower through the air, lands it full and outside off, trying to tempt the batsman, Shai allows it through.
Nice use of the feet by Hope. Takes a step forward and across and nicely works it with the turn to deep mid-wicket. A single to end the over.
Switches to 'round the wicket for Hope. Delivers it full and on off, Shai draws forward in defense.
Allows the ball to spin back in and then eases it through mid-wicket for a single.
Leans forward to a full ball and flicks it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Spinning back into the batsman from outside off, once again staying a touch low, Roston is on the back foot in defense.
Tossed up ball on middle, turned off the pads to mid-wicket for a run.
Shortish and on middle, Chase goes back and punches it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Fuller on off, Roston has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
What a delivery! Big spin there along with extra bounce. The line is outside off, Chase tries to play inside it and is beaten.
Roston Chase walks in next to bat.

OUT! Ambris is a sitting duck there. Taijul needed just two balls to strike. He dishes out a well-disguised arm ball. Lands it around off and it skids off the surface. Ambris decides to stay inside the crease and play it across the line. But it stays low and strikes him low on the pads. They appeal and the umpire is in agreement. Ambris takes the help of the technology but nothing can be done there. You cannot be more plumb than this. No inside edge either to save you. Wicket number 3 goes down.
Appeal for an lbw! Up goes the finger. Sunil Ambris wants to review the decision. That looked dead to the naked eye. Only an inside edge can save him...
Flighted delivery, landing full around off, Ambris draws forward in defense.
Taijul Islam comes into the attack.
Ambris works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Darts this full on off, Hope gets a leading edge towards point for another run.
Keeps low on the pads, turned away to square leg.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.

Well bowled. The one that goes away from the right-hander. Hope gets an outside edge towards Mahmudullah who dives to his right. Must have just fallen short of him though. They cross as the ball goes towards third man.
Given air in line of the stumps, Hope plays it with a straight bat.
SA has punched that ball through the offside.
On off, bunted down by Ambris. Windies have improved in their defense but need to apply themselves more.
The ball is down the leg side but Sunil still goes after it.
Tossed up ball on middle and off, Ambris in no hurry to keep the scoreboard ticking.
Around off, defended to the silly point fielder.
On middle, Sunil stays inside and sees this out.
Around off, Ambris gets a soft leading edge towards the point region for one.

NOT OUT! More of a formality! Arm ball on off, Ambris prods forward and looks to block this but cannot get close to the ball. Rahim behind takes the bails off and appeals. The umpire takes it up but Sunil manages to get his back leg back in time.
Stumping appeal taken up. Looks safe!
Way down leg, Ambris still flicks it but straight to square leg.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, hit towards mid on to change ends.
Similar ball on middle, Hope gets behind it and defends it.
Darts this on middle, Hope goes back and gives it back to the bowler.
On the pads, worked around the corner for nothing.
Defended off the back foot by Ambris.
On middle, tapped it front of silly point.
Tossed up ball down the leg side, milked through mid-wicket for a single.
Crouches and defends this ball inside his crease.
Flighted ball outside off, Hope stays inside and leaves it alone.
Around off, kept out by Ambris.
On the pads again, Ambris gets it off his pads towards the leg slip fielder.
Off spinner down the leg side, Hope gets behind it and flicks it through square leg for one.
Full again on middle, hit to mid-wicket.
Full on middle and leg, turned away to cow corner to get off strike.
Gives this air down leg, Ambris leaves it alone.
Loopy ball over the stumps, Hope is happy to block it out.
Stays back again and taps this in front of him.
Rocks back and bunts this one out.
Loopy ball on middle, Hope gets low and sees this out.
Arm ball on middle, Hope gets it off the inner half back to Shakib.
Off spinner on off, Hope covers his stumps and looks to block it but it goes away from him.
Sunil Ambris walks in next.

OUT! Stumped! This is inexplicable. Powell decided very early that he will use his feet. Maybe, the last ball was playing in his mind. Maybe, he didn't want to get caught napping inside the crease and get out either bowled or lbw. So, what does he do? He dances down the track even before the bowler has released the ball. All too easy for Mehidy. He bowls it wide outside off, Powell is already down the track and has no other option but to try and play at it. The ball however spins away sharply to beat his bat. An easy stumping for Rahim. Kieran will have to give a lot of explanation for this shot selection. If I remember properly, he was stumped almost in an exact manner in the second innings of the first Test match. Not sure what they lack more, skill or temperament...
Half shout for an lbw! A slider landing around off, Powell is on the front foot in defense but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Fires one in on middle, it's worked through square leg for a run.
Shortish and on off, defended off the back foot.
Tossed up ball on middle and off, defended off the front foot.
Fuller and on middle, Powell uses his feet and drives it through mid on for a run.
Full on middle, Hope blocks it out.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up ball on off, Powell looks to sweep it but it comes off the gloves and goes over the keeper. They pick up another three runs as the ball rolls towards third man.
On the pads again, worked away to square leg.
Down the leg side, Hope flicks it through square leg. It doesn't go all the way but enough for them to pick up three runs.
Fuller ball in line of the stumps, Hope is solid in his defense.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

DROPPED! Loopy ball outside off, Powell comes down the track to block it but gets an outside edge towards the keeper. Rahim fails to collect it. It then rebounds towards the second slip fielder who too cannot hold onto it. Tough chance for him though.
Outside off, punched off the back foot by Powell towards mid off.
The ball strikes the batsman very low on the pads. They pick up a single. Leg byes signalled by the umpire.
Comes down the track and works this to the on side for another run.
Full on middle, Hope once again gets it through that mid on region for a run.
On middle and leg, Hope turns it through mid-wicket to get off the mark.
Shai Hope is the number 3 batsman.

OUT! Oh dear! Shakib gets his counterpart once again. What is even happening? Fuller arm ball on off, skids inside. Kraigg shuffles across and looks to flick it away. Misses it completely and gets caught in front on his back leg. Shakib appeals and the umpire raises his finger. Brathwaite doesn't even bother reviewing it as he knows he is plumb. Now then, the replays later on show us that there might have been a faint inside edge before the ball hit the pads. How did Kraigg not know? The bat was too close to the ground. He perhaps thought it must have hit the turf.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Down the leg side, Kraigg looks to work it away but gets it off his pad towards fine leg for one.
Outside off, guided to the short third man fielder.
Loopy ball around off, Brathwaite gets low to block it.
